reference.title: Create a Client API Key
reference.shortdesc: This section describes the process of creating a client API key.

section.p: This section describes the process of creating a client API key.

li.p: Create an API key in the ADI OtoSense™ SMS web application.
To create an API key, you must be an administrator of your ADI OtoSense™ SMS tenant.
You will be provided with a Client ID and a Client Secret.

ol.li: Record the Client ID and Client Secret, as it will be required to generate a token.

section.title: Result
section.p: The Client ID and Client Secret must meet the following requirements:

ul.li: Consider them sensitive credentials and secure them appropriately.
Do not use them in front-end single-page applications
Never commit them to source code
Do not make them generally accessible

section.p: The assigned user role governs the API key and determines its available operations.
